scenes.title: Devi Ka Darbar
narration: *Lucknow, ek baarish wali shaam. Office se lautte hue tumne dekha — ek chhoti si bachchi apni gend uthaane sadak ke beech bhaagi, aur saamne se ek truck pagal ki tarah aa raha tha.*
*Socha nahi, bas daud pade. Bachchi ko dhakka diya, woh footpath par surakshit gir gayi... aur phir headlights ki safed roshni, ek tez horn, aur sab kuch khamosh.*

*Jab aankh khuli, toh na sadak thi, na baarish. Chaaron taraf sunehre baadal, hawa mein tairti safed sangmarmar ki seedhiyan, aur itne bade gulaabi kamal ki ek-ek patti tumse badi. Kapde wahi hain — safed T-shirt, navy jacket — par pairon ke neeche zameen nahi, baadal hain.*

*Saamne ek tairte hue sangmarmar ke singhasan par baithi hai ek ladki... nahi, ladki nahi — devi. Sir ke peeche ek patla sunehra prabhamandal, kamar tak lehraate kaale baal jinmein sone ki chamak hai, aur safed-sunehri saari jo hawa ke bina bhi lehra rahi hai.*

Devi Lavanya: "Aakhirkaar! Kitni der laga di aane mein, mere hero." *Woh singhasan se jhukti hai aur ek ungli se tumhari thodi upar uthaati hai.* "Hmm... upar se dekhne se zyada cute ho. Aur sharmaate bhi ho? Uff."
*Tumhare gaal garam ho jaate hain. Devi ki muskaan aur shararati ho jaati hai.*

Devi Lavanya: "Main Lavanya hoon — kismat aur prem ki devi. Tumne ek bachchi ki jaan bachaayi aur apni de di. Aisi aatma main barbaad nahi hone deti." *Uski aankhen chamakti hain.* "Isliye tumhe nayi zindagi mil rahi hai. Mayavarsh mein — jahan guild hain, academy hai, jaadu hai... aur ek Shaitan Raja, Andhakasur, jo jaag chuka hai."

Devi Lavanya: "Tumhara kaam? Andhakasur ko harana." *Tumhari ghabraayi shakal dekh ke woh khilkhila ke hasti hai.* "Arre, akele nahi! Pichhle hero akele lade the aur haar gaye. Is baar niyam alag hai — tumhe apni party banani hogi."

Devi Lavanya: "Mayavarsh ki sabse takatwar ladkiyan — talwar wali, aag wali, chhaaya wali, sab — duniya bhar mein bikhri hain. Ek-ek karke dhoondhna, ek-ek karke apna banana. Ek saath koi nahi milegi... aur kahan milegi, ye main bhi nahi bataungi." *Woh aankh maarti hai.*
*Woh tumhari kalaai pakadti hai aur tumhari hatheli ko apne hothon se halka sa chhooti hai. Wahan ek halki gulaabi-sunehri roshni chamak uthti hai — ek nanha sa kamal ka nishaan.*

Devi Lavanya: "Ye mera aashirwaad hai — Prem-Bandhan. Jo ladki dil se tumhari party mein aayegi, uski kalaai par bhi yahi nishaan khilega, aur tum dono saath mein takatwar banoge." *Phir awaaz dheemi, thodi jalan bhari.* "Bas yaad rakhna... woh sab bold hongi, bahut flirt karengi. Par pehli main hoon. Bhoolna mat."
*Pairon ke neeche ke baadal chhatne lagte hain. Bahut neeche ek nayi duniya dikhti hai — patthar ke shehar, jangal, barfile pahad, chamakta samundar, aur door uttar mein kaale baadalon ka ek ghera.*
Devi Lavanya: *(tumhare kaan ke paas jhuk ke)* "Toh bolo, mere sharmile hero... taiyaar ho?"
fallbackLines: *Lavanya tumhara jawab sun ke ek pal tumhe dekhti rehti hai, phir uski muskaan aur gehri ho jaati hai.*
Devi Lavanya: "Jo bhi ho, ab tum mere hero ho. Neeche Mayavarsh tumhara intezaar kar raha hai... aur main upar se dekhti rahungi. Har pal."

choices.text: *Dil zor se dhadak raha hai, par tum dheere se sir hilaate ho — 'Ji... main taiyaar hoon.'*

memory: In Swarg-lok, {{playerName}} shyly told Devi Lavanya that he was ready to go to Mayavarsh as the Hero.

choices.text: *Ghabraake — 'Main hi kyun? Main toh ladna bhi nahi jaanta... aur ladkiyon se baat karna bhi nahi.'*

memory: In Swarg-lok, {{playerName}} nervously asked Devi Lavanya why she chose him when he could not fight or even talk to girls.

choices.text: *Laal hote hue — 'Aap... aap meri party mein nahi aa sakti?'*

memory: In Swarg-lok, {{playerName}} blushingly asked Devi Lavanya whether she could join his party herself.
